Piano Keyboard 🎹 — dweet d/35177 by dee-gomma
blurb: Someone built a whole animated piano in 140 characters of code, and there's a remix button right there — which means you're about six minutes away from a new side quest.

title: The Mood Board #046 — Brianna Schubert
blurb: It's one creative person's actual monthly brain-dump — Virgo-season resolutions, the fits she wore in Berlin, jobs, odd little finds — and you'll walk away with three new side quests you didn't ask for.

title: Spicy Passion Fruit Mocktail (AKA "Mockarita")
blurb: Four ingredients, but you get to char a jalapeño over open flame for smoky depth — a tiny bit of theatre for a drink that's tart, tropical, and named like it's in on the joke.

title: Tour a Family of Four's Maximalist East Harlem Apartment
blurb: Four people, one apartment, zero fear of colour or clutter — this is the warm, object-stuffed, every-wall-has-a-story energy you keep chasing, and it proves a home can be maximal without ever feeling messy.

title: Cafe Yasuragi, Millenia Walk
blurb: Tucked inside Millenia Walk with deep teal walls and tan leather booths, it's a moody little hideout that basically begs you to bring the film camera and shoot a whole persona in the corner booth.

title: Coffee Receipt Stories
blurb: Tiny illustrated stories drawn on the backs of real coffee receipts by Odding — pure analog, hand-made scrapbook charm, exactly the kind of quiet find you'd want to click through one receipt at a time.
